merge_faiss_indexes_to_ondisk: merge multiple FAISS index files into a single OnDiskInvertedLists index and write the output
load_faiss_index_mmap: load a FAISS index file using memory-mapped read-only I/O flags for efficient access
extract_index_ivf: extract the IVF component from a FAISS index to access its inverted lists
crop_invlists: crop inverted lists to a specified range using l0 and l1 list index bounds
write_faiss_index: write a FAISS index object to disk as an output index file
